title: Mobile handoff protocol for intermittent networks (PRD sketch)
body:
Summary:
This is a working PRD sketch for a lightweight client↔hosted API handoff protocol intended to make Redwood's Hosted API robust on intermittent mobile networks. Goal is to let mobile apps: 1) begin an interactive session on-device, 2) stream partial results to the hosted runtime when connectivity allows, and 3) gracefully hand off responsibility for long-running or tool-backed work to the hosted infrastructure with deterministic replay and minimal developer friction.

Why this matters / Problem statement:
- Mobile apps frequently switch networks (wifi <-> cellular), background/foreground, or go offline entirely. Existing streaming patterns either break (timeouts) or force apps to re-run prompts which increases cost and creates inconsistent outputs.
- Developers building mobile experiences need reliable handoff and deterministic replay to provide consistent, cost-effective outcomes.
